speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your mother is concerned about her daughter's attention issues and behavioral changes. To help me understand what's going on, can you tell me how old she is and when you first noticed these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 15-year-old female. The patient's mother reports her daughter has been performing poorly academically since starting high school. The mother is concerned about her daughter's lack of communication and perceives her daughter as having attention issues.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy (JME)

The patient is a 15-year-old female with new-onset attention deficits, academic decline, and social withdrawal since starting high school. While these symptoms can suggest ADHD, the timing and behavioral shift in adolescence are highly suggestive of a new-onset seizure disorder.

REQUEST TEST: EEG (Electroencephalogram)
